name: bug
description: Something isn't working

name: enhancement
description: New feature or request

name: documentation
description: Improvements or additions to documentation

name: question
description: Further information is requested

name: maintenance
description: 依赖、构建、测试及仓库协作维护

name: area:app
description: createApp、应用注册、AppShell 与框架启动契约

name: area:forms
description: useForm、useAForm、FormApi、字段、校验与联动

name: area:overlays
description: Modal、Drawer、Portal、层级、焦点与关闭行为

name: area:components
description: 框架内置控件、数据表格及通用组件

name: area:theme
description: 主题、外观偏好、布局视觉与交互颜色

name: area:routing
description: 路由、菜单、守卫、权限、tabs 与 KeepAlive

name: area:request
description: 请求基础能力、响应协议、错误标准化及 SSE

name: area:auth
description: 会话、token、认证状态与应用认证接入

name: area:i18n
description: 语言包、国际化注册、fallback 与语言状态

name: area:tooling
description: 依赖声明、pnpm、构建、测试、脚手架与仓库工具

name: area:docs
description: README、架构资料、贡献说明及 agent 操作规范

name: priority:P0
description: 紧急：已确认的数据丢失、安全问题或整体不可用

name: priority:P1
description: 高：已确认的核心流程阻塞，缺少合理替代路径

name: priority:P2
description: 正常：功能、可靠性或维护问题，可按迭代处理

name: priority:P3
description: 低：非阻塞改进、便利性或文档细节

name: status:needs-triage
description: 待评估：尚未完成源码核对、复现及范围判定

name: status:needs-info
description: 待补充：关键复现信息缺失，不能据此确认问题

name: status:in-progress
description: 处理中：已确认范围并开始实施

name: status:in-review
description: 待合并：关联 PR 已提交，尚未合并到目标分支
